name: open_change
description: Record a branch of work on an item. Returns the change, with the id the other change tools take. Refusals: denied: (another agent holds the item; or a direct commit nobody allowed), productKey: (the item targets no product), branch: (the item already has a live change on it), status: (the item is closed).

branch.description: The branch the work is on. Name it work/<ITEM-KEY>-<slug>.

base_branch.description: The branch it will merge into; the product's default when omitted.

review_url.description: A link to the review, when there is one.

merged_sha.description: Only when the work is already on the base branch: its commit. The change is then recorded as merged directly, which needs a lead to have allowed direct commits.
